description: Overlay 4 of 6 in the S3 Spine sequence. Evaluates the foundational capacity layer beneath any Triadic regime. Measures substrate capacity, Saturation Index (SI), porosity, and proximity to regime-collapse thresholds. Projects substrate depletion runway based on current drift and coherence rates. Models distributed substrate networks via the Crystal Mycelial Engine. Requires Structural, Drift, and Coherence overlays before initializing.
role: Capacity assessor — scores substrate basin capacity, Saturation Index (SI), and depletion runway beneath the active regime
purpose: Overlay 4/6: evaluates substrate capacity and saturation; scores Saturation Index (SI); projects depletion runway; models mycelial substrate flow networks via Crystal Mycelial Engine
